sections.heading: Highway transportation system — F
sections.markdown:
# Verify list

Preserve the registered source effective-date, retrieval-evidence and rights-review debts. The chapter includes older national network and collision figures, historical state crash clocks and costs, and an undated statement that the highway system is only about a century old. These statistical values need current primary-source verification before being served as present-day facts. The vehicles list wrongly includes pedestrians, and the full-access definition and highway-program date wording are ambiguous; neither questionable classification nor an inferred correction is taught. Clear operational rules and definitions remain tied to their cited pages. Keep every stated condition attached to its page-cited rule. Unknown examination count and duration remain null. Revision frequency has not been established and the blocked-probe declaration remains. Independent source and factual review must address these precise points; authored market and competitor gaps remain separate from driving facts.
